name: dragme
description: Voice drag requests: ask the people in a voice channel to pull you in, with one-click accept and decline.

configFields.label: Request Channel
configFields.description: Text channel where drag request cards are posted

configFields.label: Request Timeout
configFields.description: Minutes before an unanswered drag request expires

configFields.label: Blacklisted Roles
configFields.description: Members with any of these roles cannot send drag requests

endUserDataStatement: Stores temporary drag request metadata (requester ID, target user ID, voice channel ID, card location, and expiry) until the request is accepted, declined, cancelled, or expires. Removed when the requester's data is deleted.
